result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a text rendering/overlap bug in the restaurant listing details.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing shows garbled metadata text: '25-3€0 delivery • Ramen'. The delivery time ('25-35 min') and the free delivery label ('€0 delivery') appear to be incorrectly merged or overlapping, resulting in broken, unreadable text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time string and the delivery cost label are rendered as separate, properly spaced UI elements or concatenated with correct formatting, e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'.
